title: Love it!
text: Love it!. Love it!  It's big enough for 2 people to sit on and it is so comfortable.  It didn't take long to completely poof up.  It is so much better than the old fashion "bean" bag chairs.  The memory foam fluffs back up and when it gets out of shape, just roll it around a bit and it's back to "new".  The outside comes off if you need to clean it but it's also easy to spot clean.

product_metadata.title: Comfy Sacks Memory Foam Bean Bag Chair, Black Faux Leather
features: Ultra soft removable and machine washable cover
Durable inner liner with child safety zipper
Huge selection of colors and fabrics available
description: The 6ft lounger immediately rose to our top sellers because of many people wanting to have more space to actually stretch out. If the 6ft Sack is great for long hours of sitting and napping, the 6ft lounger is big enough for two large adults to actually sleep on. It is also great as a couch so many families think this lounger is perfect for family gatherings and parties. Other than that, it is simply wonderful for just quality time in home theatres and family rooms.
